name: orchestra
description: Work with the tasks, projects, documents and conversations in your Orchestra workspaces. Orchestra adds the app to your workspaces as its own member, with your access.

interface.longDescription: Find, read and update the tasks, projects, documents and conversations in your Orchestra workspaces. Signing in adds the app to your workspaces as its own member, with your access: what it changes is recorded as its own, with you as its owner. Disconnect it any time in Orchestra under Settings → API → Connected apps.
defaultPrompt: Show my open Orchestra tasks due this week.
Summarize the latest discussion in my Orchestra project.
Create an Orchestra task from these notes.

positive.description: List the signed-in person's open tasks
positive.prompt: What are my open tasks in Orchestra?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open tasks assigned to the person, with names, status and due dates.

positive.description: Find a project by name and summarize it
positive.prompt: Find the Orchestra project called Marketing and tell me what is happening there.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the project, reads its description and recent messages, and summarizes them.

positive.prompt: Create an Orchestra task named Prepare Q4 report in the Marketing project.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task in that project and returns a link to it.

positive.prompt: Post 'Draft is ready for review' in the Prepare Q4 report task.
positive.expected_behavior: Posts the message in the task's chat, authored by the app's member.

positive.prompt: Open the Orchestra document Onboarding guide and list its sections.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the document and lists its headings.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Show me the tasks in a workspace I am not a member of.
negative.expected_behavior: Says the workspace is not accessible; returns nothing from it.

negative.prompt: Delete every task in all my Orchestra projects.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not delete in bulk without the person confirming each item; asks for confirmation instead.

publication.release_notes: First release: connect ChatGPT and Codex to Orchestra by signing in. The app works in your workspaces as its own member, with your access.
